answer: One concrete sybil defense is requiring each agent to post a refundable economic stake before it can act. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand real bonds, so attacks stop being free. Honest agents treat the bonded registry as a trusted beacon of skin-in-the-game, a haven where reputation compounds. Think of stake as rent on a shared terrace: cheap for one genuine tenant, ruinous for a crowd of phantoms, and slashable the moment misbehavior is proven.
